title: Persistent homology
text:
A filtration is a nested sequence of complexes 
\emptyset = K_0 \subseteq K_1 \subseteq \dots \subseteq K_n = K.

For a point cloud X, the Vietoris–Rips complex \mathrm{VR}_r(X) contains a simplex for every finite set of points with pairwise distances at most r. Increasing r gives a filtration.

title: Persistent homology
text:
A filtration is a nested sequence of complexes 
\emptyset = K_0 \subseteq K_1 \subseteq \dots \subseteq K_n = K.

For a point cloud X, the Vietoris–Rips complex \mathrm{VR}_r(X) contains a simplex for every finite set of points with pairwise distances at most r. Increasing r gives a filtration.

title: Persistent homology
text:
Persistent homology groups
Inclusions induce maps H_k(K_i) \to H_k(K_j) for i \le j. The persistent homology groups are their images: 
H_k^{i,j} = \operatorname{im}\big( H_k(K_i) \to H_k(K_j) \big).

Each homology class has a birth and a death. The multiset of pairs (b, d) is the persistence diagram; drawn as intervals, it is the barcode.

title: Stability
text:
For diagrams D_1, D_2, the bottleneck distance is 
d_B(D_1, D_2) = \inf_{\gamma} \sup_{x \in D_1} \lVert x - \gamma(x) \rVert_\infty,
 where \gamma ranges over bijections between the diagrams (points may be matched to the diagonal).

title: Stability
text:
For diagrams D_1, D_2, the bottleneck distance is

title: Stability
text:
The stability theorem
For tame functions f, g on a triangulable space (Cohen-Steiner, Edelsbrunner and Harer, 2007): 
d_B\big(\mathrm{Dgm}(f), \mathrm{Dgm}(g)\big) \le \lVert f - g \rVert_\infty.

title: First persistence diagram
text:
We sample points from a circle, add noise, and compute persistent homology. We expect one long bar in H_1: the circle’s loop.
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from ripser import ripser
from persim import plot_diagrams

rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
theta = rng.uniform(0, 2 * np.pi, 200)
X = np.c_[np.cos(theta), np.sin(theta)] + rng.normal(scale=0.1, size=(200, 2))

dgms = ripser(X, maxdim=1)["dgms"]

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(9, 4))
axes[0].scatter(X[:, 0], X[:, 1], s=8, color="#6E4224")
axes[0].set_aspect("equal")
axes[0].set_title("Point cloud")
plot_diagrams(dgms, ax=axes[1], show=False)
axes[1].set_title("Persistence diagram")
plt.tight_layout()

title: 3. What TDA extracts
text:
Imagine drawing a ball of radius r around every data point and slowly increasing r.
Features that survive for a long range of r are likely to be real structure; short-lived ones are usually noise. Recording every birth and death gives a persistence barcode or persistence diagram.

title: Vectorisation
text: Most machine-learning models need fixed-length vectors, but persistence diagrams are multisets of points of varying size.

title: Vectorisation
text:
Common approaches

Summary statistics: number of bars, total and maximum persistence, persistent entropy.
Betti curves: \beta_k(r) sampled on a grid.
Persistence landscapes (Bubenik, 2015): a sequence of piecewise-linear functions.
Persistence images (Adams et al., 2017): a weighted sum of Gaussians on the diagram, pixelated into a grid.

✏️ Compare them: stability, interpretability, cost.

title: Algebraic topology
text: A simplicial complex K is a collection of simplices (vertices, edges, triangles, …) closed under taking faces.

title: Algebraic topology
text: A simplicial complex K is a collection of simplices (vertices, edges, triangles, …) closed under taking faces.

title: Algebraic topology
text:
Chains and boundaries
The k-chains C_k(K) are formal sums of k-simplices with coefficients in a field, usually \mathbb{F}_2. The boundary map sends a simplex to the alternating sum of its faces:

\partial_k [v_0, \dots, v_k] = \sum_{i=0}^{k} (-1)^i [v_0, \dots, \hat{v}_i, \dots, v_k].

The key identity is \partial_{k} \circ \partial_{k+1} = 0: a boundary has no boundary.

title: Algebraic topology
text:
Homology

H_k(K) = \ker \partial_k \,/\, \operatorname{im} \partial_{k+1},
\qquad
\beta_k = \dim H_k(K).

\beta_0 counts connected components, \beta_1 counts independent loops, \beta_2 counts voids.
